title: Allow to set a video as desktop background
line: Videos (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV) can now be set as the desktop wallpaper and play muted in a loop.
explanation: The Image wallpaper only knew still, animated and vector images: video files were not offered in its file picker or folder scans, and a video set as wallpaper was rejected as an unsupported type and replaced by the default wallpaper. The change adds a Video background type for video/* files, lists MP4, QuickTime, WebM and Matroska files in the picker, wallpaper folders and slideshows, and plays them with a new QtMultimedia-based VideoComponent: muted, looping, honouring the positioning modes and blur, and paused while a maximized window covers the screen (like animated images, also following the existing ForceImageAnimation setting). Desktop drops and Dolphin's 'Set as Wallpaper' now accept the same video types.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: support videos as wallpapers

The image wallpaper only accepted image files, so a video picked as
wallpaper fell back to the default one. Common video formats can now be
picked and are played muted in a loop, pausing like animated images.

BUG: 455184

media.caption: Master: ~/wave.mp4 set as the Image wallpaper is rejected ('Unknown or unsupported background type … video/mp4') and the default wallpaper is shown
Patched: the same mp4 plays as the wallpaper and loops (timecode goes 7.1 → 0.1 and on)
Master: Desktop and Wallpaper > Add… in the home folder, filter 'Media Files': wave.mp4 and small.webm are not listed
Patched: the same dialog lists wave.mp4 and small.webm; picking small.webm adds it to the wallpaper grid
Patched: maximizing Konsole for ~4 s pauses the video (01.0 before, 01.6 after restoring), as animated wallpapers do
Patched: a 480x360 WebM with Positioning 'Centered' and blur on: native size in the middle, blurred copy filling the rest
